# mike

> A reverse proxy for Claude Code's traffic to api.anthropic.com. It records every request and response on your machine, shows them in a web UI, lets Claude Code query that history over MCP, and, only when switched on, changes what is sent (lessons, nudges, prompt rewrites, shortened tool output) and starts and coordinates Claude Code sessions. Rust workspace (`crates/mike`, `crates/mike-mcp`, `crates/proxy-forward`) plus a SvelteKit SPA (`frontend/`).

Read docs/SYSTEM_MAP.md first: it lists every capability with its code location, surface (CLI, REST, MCP, web UI, terminal UI), default and deeper doc, and the commands that print the authoritative lists.

## Authoritative sources in the code

- CLI: `crates/mike/src/cli.rs`, `crates/mike/src/config/subcommands/mod.rs`, `mike --help`.
- MCP tools: `crates/mike-mcp/src/tools/catalogue.rs`, `mike-mcp list-tools --full --json`.
- REST routes: `crates/mike/src/api/manifest/*.rs`.
- Pipeline order: `pipeline::STAGE_ORDER` in `crates/mike/src/pipeline/mod.rs`.
- Feature toggles: `crates/mike/src/feature_toggles/mod.rs`.
- Workers: `crates/mike/src/serve/workers.rs`.
- Web UI routes: `frontend/src/routes/`.
- Migrations: `crates/mike/src/store/persistence/migrations/`.
